content:
alex: Heads up — aiming to publish py/ts SDKs in the 2am UTC change window tonight (2am-3am). Can we lock down pin strategy and whether to auto-deprecate legacy sync?
maya: +1 for the window. what's the canary KPI? failures in internal e2e?
ben: Canary CI is flapping on auth tests, failing ~5% on nightlies. logs: `auth_test.go:142: token mismatch`
sam: If CI is flaky I'd recommend shadow publish then gated rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%). Avoid immediate dist-tag flip.
alex: Thinking: publish under `next` tag first, run telemetry for 60m, then flip `latest` if no regressions. Also propose pinning old sync client as `0.x-legacy` and adding deprecation notice in release notes.
maya: Ok for `next` tag. For release notes: include migration snippet and deprecation timeline. I'll draft bullet points.
ben: One risk: npm publish user tokens expire. Can deploybot attempt and fail; we should pre-validate creds. @deploybot can you run a dry run?
deploybot: [BOT] Starting dry-run publish for packages: `@redwood/sdk-py`, `@redwood/sdk-ts`...
deploybot: [BOT] Dry-run complete — checksum OK, auth OK, no rate-limits detected.
sam: Nice. For pip: publish wheel + sdist. Make sure GPG signing included.
alex: Also need to pin our example repos to the canary tag so docs users don't get broken examples. I'll open a PR after publish.
maya: About deprecation: propose 90-day sunset for sync client after GA + deprecation header in pkg docs and upgrade guide.
ben: Agree. Also add a runtime feature flag to opt-out of new behavior for enterprise customers during rollout.
sam: Ops question: if canary telemetry shows a 2x error rate, what's rollback plan? manual yank + dist-tag revert?
alex: Rollback plan: yank new pkg versions from registries (npm unpublish isn't ideal), so we prefer to flip dist-tag back and publish a hotfix patch to `latest` channel. For pip, yanking is harder — instead publish a patch version with revert.
maya: I'll prepare release notes draft and deprecation blurb now: https://git.redwood/release-notes/drafts/sdk-release-2634506789
ben: I'll keep an eye on canary CI and auth tests, will triage immediately if flake reproduces.
sam: Let's also add a short smoke test to the release job that hits onboarding example endpoints. If that fails, autobail.
alex: Sounds good. Final checklist: 1) dry-run ✅ 2) push canary `next` tag ✅ 3) monitor 60m ✅ 4) if stable flip `latest`, otherwise patch and inform customers ✅
maya: +1. I'll post release notes and ping #customers before flip.
release-bot: [BOT] Scheduled change window reminder: py/ts SDK publish at 02:00 UTC. Automated notifications will go to #devex and #support 15m prior.
alex: Thanks all — I'll start the publish at 01:55 UTC and post updates here. :rocket:
